notes: The source calls the outcome severe adverse events (Table 2 also labels these SAE), rather than serious adverse events. It reports ten events, with 4 in LcS and 6 in Placebo, not apparently related to the investigational product; the abstract statement of no intervention-related adverse events is not an all-cause zero. Counts are described as events, without explicitly distinguishing events from unique affected participants. Table 2 states arm totals of 181 and 178 and 359 with values (0 missing); these match the explicitly randomised totals in the abstract. The window quoted is the general study follow-up; an SAE-specific assessment window is NOT_IN_PACKET.
